title: Messages keep accents and line breaks in compose URLs; an unlimited cap is still tracked
steps: Build URIs from a message with accents, punctuation and line breaks; try chat URLs with a wrong host/credentials/script and a counter of 0.
expect: Compose doors only create a draft message, which decodes back verbatim.
Chat accepts only known valid URLs; a cap of 0 does not block, and a batch over the cap is blocked.
Instagram/Facebook profiles are turned into the ig.me/m or m.me chat doors; existing chat routes stay as they are, and feature pages never become recipients.
fence: Durable receipts, fixed identities, site permissions, leases and the daily-cap transaction; URLs are compose/copy only.

tests: compose links preserve punctuation, accents and line breaks in the draft; none sends it
known other chats open their existing URL; invalid hosts, credentials and scripts are refused
daily usage disables a batch before it would exceed the cap; zero stays uncapped
Instagram and Facebook profile contacts open direct chat routes instead of profiles
